message: Muse Wonder esta imaginando tres juegos

concepts.controls: PRESS ARROW KEYS or WASD to tiptoe, HOLD SPACE to pull the rug over you, RELEASE SPACE to pop out, press ENTER to start
concepts.core_mechanic: The rug is your only portable shadow. Out in the lamp's big swinging circle of light, moving makes the cat's Wake Meter fill fast — but hold Space and your mouse vanishes into a slow, creeping rug-lump that can cross bright floor safely. Pop out to grab a cheese bite, then sneak it home with your little feet sticking out from under the rug, moving 30% faster and filling the meter 30% faster each trip. Every 20 seconds the lamp swings wider and faster, so later trips are a gamble: slow and safe under the rug, or fast and exposed.
concepts.juice: Title screen: the huge sleeping cat curled around the words SQUEAK IN THE DARK, one Zzz bobbing up and down, the rug-lump creeping across the bottom whenever you press an arrow. Juice: dust motes sparkle inside the lamp beam, soft paw-pad particles puff on carpet and loud yellow 'squeak!' stars burst on bare floor, the mouse squash-and-stretches with each tiptoe step and flattens completely when the rug drops on him, the cat's whiskers twitch and its tail thumps with a tiny screen shake as the Wake Meter climbs, and each cheese delivered pops a floating '+1 BITE!' in cheesy yellow. When the cat wakes, the lamp flares white, the screen shakes hard, and the cat uncurls in one big stretchy pounce.
concepts.lose: You lose if the Wake Meter fills — the cat's eyes snap open and it pounces on the mouse.
concepts.palette: Warm midnight-parlor colors pulled from the drawings themselves: cozy amber and butter-yellow lamplight on a deep blue-brown wooden floor, the red striped rug as the single bold splash of color, the mouse in soft pencil grays with a pink nose, the cat in warm orange tabby stripes, the cheese in bright holey yellow, and the sleepy Zzz's in pale crayon blue.
concepts.pitch: A tiny mouse, a huge wedge of cheese, and one very light sleeper — the only shadow in this lamplit room is the rug, and you can wear it. Drag it, hide under it, and dash out for cheese bite by bite before the cat opens its eyes.

roles.role: You — the player character, a big hand-drawn sprite that tiptoes, freezes, and disappears under the rug
The danger zone — a swinging floor lamp whose moving cone of light is drawn over the whole room; moving inside it wakes the cat
The sleeping threat in the corner — its twitching ears and rising chest show the Wake Meter before it ever opens its eyes
The sleep gauge — big blue Zzz's float up from the cat; the faster and smaller they come, the closer it is to waking
The prize — one giant wedge you carry home in three bites, each bite making the next run riskier
Your hiding place — the red rug you drag and wear as a mobile shadow, drawn large and center-stage

concepts.title: Squeak in the Dark (wear the rug!)
concepts.win: You win by carrying all 3 cheese bites back to your mouse hole before the cat wakes.

concepts.controls: PRESS ARROW KEYS or WASD to take one tiptoe step (on the beat!), TAP SPACE to freeze and hold your breath, press ENTER to start
concepts.core_mechanic: The whole room breathes with the cat's snore. The lamp pulses yellow on every beat and a Zzz floats across the top of the screen — step exactly when it pops and you're silent, step off-beat and you squeak. Rug squares are rest spots where you can safely wait or step late once. Grab the cheese and the snore flips to double-time for the run home, with the tempo climbing from a sleepy 80 to a panicky 140 beats per minute over the minute. Missing gets harder to survive because at high tempo even standing in lamplight during a 'wake-up sniff' (the cat inhales, lamp goes red for 2 beats) counts as a squeak unless you're frozen with Space.
concepts.juice: Title screen: TIPTOE ON THE SNORE with the lamp pulsing to the menu music and the mouse bouncing in place, begging you to press Enter on the beat (do it and he does a happy spin). Juice: a golden ring closes on the cheese icon to show the perfect-step window, 'PERFECT!' 'GOOD' and 'SQUEAK!' pop in crayon letters, perfect steps leave little musical-note trails and build a combo counter ('x8 SILENT STREAK!'), the cat's belly squash-and-stretches with every snore, and a squeak makes the lamp flicker, the cat's ear snap toward you, and the screen give a nervous wobble. The double-time escape makes everything bounce twice as fast.
concepts.lose: You lose if you squeak 3 times — the third squeak wakes the cat for a pounce.
concepts.palette: A cozy nighttime stage in deep indigo and warm wood brown, lit by the lamp's buttery yellow beat-pulse that flashes soft red on danger beats, the red rug squares glowing like safe little islands, the gray mouse popping against the dark with his pink nose, the orange cat warm and huge at the top of the screen, the cheese a bright yellow spotlight-stealer, and pale blue Zzz's drifting across like sleepy musical notes.
concepts.pitch: The cat snores in perfect time, and a smart mouse dances to it. Tiptoe across the lamplit floor one beat at a time, steal the cheese, and run home when the snore goes double-time.

roles.role: You — a dancer-thief who steps tile to tile, freezes mid-pose, and spins when a steal succeeds
The metronome — its light pulses on the beat and turns red during dangerous 'sniff' beats
The drummer — its snoring belly sets the tempo, and its ears judge every off-beat squeak
The beat track — Zzz's float across the screen and pop exactly when you should step
The goal that changes the music — grabbing it flips the snore to double-time for the escape
Safe tiles — rug squares forgive one late step and let you wait out a rhythm safely

concepts.title: Tiptoe on the Snore
concepts.win: You win by crossing the floor on the beat, grabbing the cheese, and making it back to your hole in double-time.

concepts.controls: PRESS ARROW KEYS or WASD to walk and push (one square at a time), HOLD SPACE to peek at the shadow map, press ENTER to start or restart a room
concepts.core_mechanic: Lamplight is lava and shadows are the floor. You can only stand on shadowed squares, and every pushable thing — the folded rug, the cheese, even the round sleeping cat — casts a shadow away from the lamp. The surprise: the curled-up cat is a boulder. Push it and it rolls until it hits a wall, sleepy the whole way, laying down a huge cat-shaped shadow bridge wherever it lands. Plan each room (3 small rooms, about 90 seconds total) so the shadows connect your hole to the cheese — but mind the Zzz's: every 15 pushes one Z pops, and when they're all gone the cat wakes wherever it ended up. Push a Z back over the cat to restore its nap and buy more moves.
concepts.juice: Title screen: PUSH THE DARK HOME over a little lamplit grid where the cat slowly rolls back and forth on its own, painting and repainting a shadow path the mouse keeps tiptoeing across. Juice: shadows snap onto the grid with a soft 'whump' and a puff of blue dust, the rug unfolds with a stretchy flap when it lands, the cat rolls with squash-and-stretch and a sleepy motion trail while its Zzz's wobble but don't break, pushing the cheese leaves a crumb trail, and solving a room pops a crayon 'SHADOW PATH!' banner as the mouse does a proud cheese-lift. Popping the last Z gets a slow zoom on the cat's blinking eyes and a gentle, disappointed screen shake.
concepts.lose: You lose if you step into lamplight 3 times, box the cheese into a dead corner, or pop all the Zzz's — any of these wakes the cat.
concepts.palette: A toy-room diorama in warm midnight blues and browns, every lit square glowing the lamp's rich butter-yellow and every shadow a cool slate blue so the safe path reads at a glance, the red rug as the brightest pushable block, the cheese glowing pale gold, the orange cat a big warm circle dominating any room it's in, the gray mouse small and brave, and the blue Zzz's floating like precious extra lives.
concepts.pitch: The lamplight burns, the shadows are safe, and the best building block in the room is the cat itself. Push lampside furniture — and roll the sleeping cat — to build a road of shadow straight to the cheese.

roles.role: You — the pusher and path-walker who can only stand in shadow
The light source at the edge of each room — everything's shadow stretches away from it
A giant round pushable boulder that rolls until it hits a wall and casts the biggest shadow of all
Your move budget — floating Z's that pop as you push; push one back over the cat to restore its nap
Both cargo and cover — push it onto the rug to win the room, and hide in its shadow on the way
The goal pad and a pushable block — fold it, slide it, and use its long striped shadow as a bridge

concepts.title: Push the Dark Home
concepts.win: You win by building a connected shadow path in all 3 rooms and pushing each cheese onto its rug.

message: 3 construcciones en paralelo; gana la primera que pase los chequeos

data.advice: Winnable, and no dumb policy wins.

minor: Controls pill in top-right of gameplay overlaps the cat's Zzz art, but both stay readable
Cat and Zzz art bleeds to top/right screen edge with slight edge cropping in both captures

message: #1 Squeak in the Dark (wear the rug!) is a top-down stealth game where a tiny mouse must steal three bites from a giant cheese wedge and carry them home without waking the sleeping cat. Move with Arrow Keys or WASD, hold SPACE while on the red rug to hide and creep safely through the swinging lamplight, release SPACE to pop out and grab cheese, and steer clear of moving in bright light or the Wake Meter will fill and the cat will pounce.
